messages:
Ivy: Heads-up  late courier just rang, dropped a small crate marked 'GLASS PLAQUE - DO NOT LAY FLAT' at 19:40 and left a note. They said they'd return at 09:00 to pick up. Where should we stash it overnight?
frontdesk-bot: Package scanned: "GLASS PLAQUE" received 19:40. Current location: mailroom shelf C3. Delivery note: hold for pickup. Reply 'move' to transfer to secure storage.
Jon: We can't leave fragile in the open; mailroom gets crowded. Can we put it in Locker 2? It's lockable and padded.
mail-bot: Reminder: Locker 2 availability 19:45-08:00. Postmaster flagged as fragile. If moved, log handler name.
Kara: I can move it to Locker 2 if someone can meet me at the mailroom door at 19:55. Also, we have a 09:30 external workshop arriving (12 people) and need extra chairs and volunteer escorts.
Facilities: Locker 2 pad is clear. Will meet at mailroom at 19:55. Note: leave a 'Do not tilt' sticky and a photo of crate orientation.
Tito: I'll cover escorts for the workshop in the morning 09:15-10:00. For badges, let's do purple 'Workshop' lanyards, short-term access only.
Ivy: Thanks. frontdesk-bot can you set up preprint badges and a morning note that crates in Locker 2 must be retrieved before 09:00 by courier only?
frontdesk-bot: Preprint request queued. Badge color: purple (Workshop). Lock instructions: Locker 2 - secure storage, access only to frontdesk and Facilities. Pickup note: courier code required.
Jon: Also, yesterday a small parcel labeled 'Charger - Demo Squad' was misplaced and someone opened it by accident  turned out to be a set of adaptors for the AV cart. Is the cart available tomorrow? We need it for the workshop.
mail-bot: Parcel 'Charger - Demo Squad' located and resealed. Current holder: AV closet. AV cart scheduled for 08:45-12:00 tomorrow.
Kara: Great. Can Facilities confirm extra HDMI and a USB-C hub on the cart? One of the workshop hosts needs screen mirroring.
Facilities: Adding HDMI + USB-C hub to AV cart. Will leave a spare HDMI cable taped to the cart handle.
Tito: For workshop check-in, front desk checklist please: 1) Ask for registration name 2) Print purple lanyard 3) Hand out a small sticker 'Guest' 4) Escort to Demo Hall 2
frontdesk-bot: Check-in flow saved:
```
1) Request registration name or QR
2) Print purple lanyard + 'Guest' sticker
3) Log names on tablet -> assign temp badge expiry 12:00
4) Escort to Demo Hall 2 (no access beyond demo hall)
```
Ivy: One more thing  a visiting speaker requested a quiet corner to make a call at 09:50. Can we reserve the small phone booth for 09:45-10:00?
Jon: Phone booth B is free. I'll reserve it in calendar and leave a note on the door.
Kara: Also, reminder to label the crate orientation with an arrow and 'Do not lay flat' photo on Slack ops channel so morning crew sees it.
Facilities: Placed orientation sticker and photo on Locker 2. Tagged morning shift: @Tito @frontdesk-bot.
mail-bot: Final: crate moved to Locker 2 at 19:58 by Kara & Facilities. Photo logged. Courier return window: 09:00-09:30.
Ivy: Thank you all  appreciate the quick help. If courier doesn't pick up by 09:30, we will escalate to sender and move the plaque to secure deliveries shelf until pickup is arranged.
